reviews.review:
I've played Left4Dead 2 quite a bit back in the day. I had heard that this game was a spiritual successor to that but was busy with other games at the time to really give it a solid try. I am honestly sad to say that I was busy because this game does not deserve a single ounce of the hate it gets. Yes, it's not L4D3. Here's the kicker...it doesn't *need* to be.

Gameplay: The gameplay is honestly solid. The gun play mechanics across the weapons is good, consistent, and stable. It has a much larger pool of weapons compared to the previous L4D games, and that you can customize the accessories and such is a huge bonus. The card system I honestly do not see or understand why people call it 'crunchy'. All the cards are pretty self-explanatory, and the 15 card deck lets you customize any of the Cleaners to be just about whatever you want. You want to be a team medic, shotgunner, melee brawler, sniper, LMG specialist etc? There are cards for ALL of that. And each of the Cleaners is useful in some way or form, AND you get to customize how they look and the weapons.

Audio/Video: For a game that's 4 years old and such, it looks and sounds great. The developers really have it where paying attention to the audio and such pays off. I won't lie though; sometimes there is so much going on it can be overwhelming but that's the zombie apocalypse for you.

Characters/Story: The characters actually have character to them, and occasionally you get just enough snippets of backstory for them to get a deeper look. It's just enough charm to make them interesting, and I gotta say they all look their respective parts/roles. Even the NPC's have enough charm to them to have a solid personality. The Acts all interweave with one another, and the cutscenes are just long enough.

Honestly, the game is very solid. Don't pay attention to the haters out there that are butthurt that this isn't L4D3. It's a solid game that is great with friends and even solo. I definitely recommend.
Easy to play and quick to pick up the mechanic. It's good for quick fun. The community is pretty active too. Can always find a game to join.

I'm trying extremely hard not to compare this to Left 4 Dead 2, but it's literally impossible as it has too many resemblances.

The gunplay feels great and fluid, even "orgasmic". And there are some cool, special and unique enemies. But sadly, apart from that, there isn't much to compliment.

I remember seeing this game for the first time and thinking: finally, more Left 4 Dead! However, it's essentially missing a lot that made Left 4 Dead so great. My friends and I set about to complete the game multiple times, but it never kept us hooked for some reason. Instead, we always just returned to Left 4 Dead. The whole deck customisation – including reading all the cards – isn't one of my favourite mechanics either. The cast is trying to recreate the lovable and unique dynamic of the Left 4 Dead characters, but it just can't replicate that sort of charm. It's trying to imitate every aspect of that game, and also trying to add more, yet the simplicity of the original game exceeds it in many ways. Ultimately, it falls short and loses the magic that Left 4 Dead had.
